search.Definition

This class describe parameters to retrieve data for search.

Available as lseg.data.content.search.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    query: str = None,
    view: Views | str = Views.SEARCH_ALL,
    filter: str = None,
    order_by: str = None,
    boost: str = None,
    select: str = None,
    top: int = 10,
    skip: int = 0,
    group_by: str = None,
    group_count: int = 3,
    navigators: str = None,
    features: str = None,
    scope: str = None,
    terms: str = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
query str No None Keyword argument for view
view Views | str No Views.SEARCH_ALL The view for searching see at Views enum. Default: Views.SEARCH_ALL
filter str No None Where query is for unstructured end-user-oriented restriction, filter is for structured programmatic restriction.
order_by str No None Defines the order in which matching documents should be returned.
boost str No None This argument supports exactly the same predicate expression syntax as filter, but where filter restricts which documents are matched at all, boost just applies a large scoring boost to documents it matches, which will almost always guarantee that they appear at the top of the results.
select str No None A comma-separated list of the properties of a document to be returned in the response.
top int No 10 the maximum number of documents to retrieve. Must be non-negative. default: 10
skip int No 0 The number of documents to skip in the sorted result set before returning the next top.
group_by str No None If specified, this must name a single Groupable property. returned documents are grouped into buckets based on their value for this property.
group_count int No 3 When supplied in combination with group_by, sets the maximum number of documents to be returned per bucket. default: 3
navigators str No None This can name one or more properties, separated by commas, each of which must be Navigable.
features str No None Comma-separated list of flags, typically niche or experimental things which most callers won't want
scope str No None Name of a Symbol property against which Terms will be matched Example: "RIC"
terms str No None Comma-separated list of up to 5000 symbols to be matched against the Scope property Example": "A,B,C,D"
extended_params ExtendedParams No None Other parameters can be provided if necessary

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the client file store to retrieve the previously defined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> TypeData

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

TypeData instance.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the previously defined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
) -> TypeData

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None User-defined callback function to process the retrieved data.
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response

Returns

TypeData instance

Example

from lseg.data.content import search
definition = search.Definition(query="cfo", view=search.Views.PEOPLE)
